development_entry.interpretation: Pre-evidence entry prerequisite only, not complete-route all-step-forward primary success.

frozen_protocol.adoption_rule: Primary count must exceed the paired baseline under the fixed declared caps; all unknown/timeout/error inputs reported explicitly, never imputed as zero. Final qualified results reported separately. No threshold relaxation.
frozen_protocol.baseline_common_asset_check: Current catalog/rules/model file bytes independently rehashed before treatment; match saved historical baseline predictor/catalog/rules provenance.
frozen_protocol.baseline_reuse: Historical baseline12 from the same session, not rerun; recorded synthesis runtime hashes match frozen aeb67c9 archive, and whole commit delta contains documentation/baseline records only. Timing/load differences preclude fresh randomized timing claims.
frozen_protocol.common_gate_policy: Main CLI strict property intersection (including default MW upper bound 500), current v7 original-hit bit Morgan/3D/pharmacophore/polar and full route integrity/forward support/qualification unchanged.

freeze_provenance.execution: Only route_first once; historical baseline reused; no retries; no scientific thresholds or caps changed at freeze

frozen_protocol.generation_difference: Baseline native designs plus SynLlama proposals and bounded catalog projection/expansion. Route-first actual catalog/rule products become self-product designs (Tanimoto1 to design is tautological); no native/SynLlama generation or route expansion. max_designs3 caps route-first distinct products entering downstream screening, while legacy three designs can project more exact products. Do not hide this asymmetry or raise caps after outcomes.
outputs: complete run status and exit code
complete route IDs and step depths
frozen_protocol.panel_scope: Same 12 public development inputs across six targets; reused development panel, not held-out; no experimental synthesis or activity claim.

preparation_environment.test_only_environment_change: pytest-cov 7.0.0 and coverage 7.13.4 installed with --no-deps; scientific packages unchanged

previous_attempt.scope: Same development panel reused after observed failed attempt; no independent/held-out claim.

frozen_protocol.primary_metric: Number of completed inputs with at least one exact changed-scaffold product whose complete concrete route passes atom/stereo audit and per-step forward support; unique input/product pairs and route counts are secondary.

rejected_development_variants.decision: Coverage regressed3→2; restoredv7 runtime. These additional feature-perception limits are not active in the retained implementation.

limits.accounting: Cache success/failure signatures; charge all uncached perception attempts including failures; report requests/cache hits/ranking work separately. Additional bounded CPU work, not equal compute to previous diagnostics. Existing catalog/fingerprint/combination/product/route/model/wall limits unchanged.
limits.feature_semantics: Existing similarity_constraints.feature_records and POLAR families; unweighted per-family count L1 distance, penalizing deficits and excess.
limits.incomplete_scoring: Use the exact prior selection on failed/unavailable feature signatures, work exhaustion or deadline; do not rank a partially evaluated prefix.
limits.query_scope: One normalized precursor guide and candidates from the already visited, role-compatible ranked pool; no added catalog scan.
limits.selection: Keep the exact previous first choice; choose the second by existing posting-backed known-anchor priority, polar distance, fingerprint similarity and SMILES. Preserve remaining original order without duplication.

frozen_protocol.resource_accounting: Wall clock includes per-child imports, asset/catalog/model loading, candidate generation, forward evidence, 3D and refinement. Preparation/source archival and offline analysis are outside the per-input cap and reported separately. Fixed physical GPU lanes preserve each paired input GPU type; route-first may leave assigned GPU idle because its forward predictor is CPU. No per-process memory cap is claimed. Baseline elapsed timings are descriptive prior-run values, not a fresh concurrent or randomized timing comparison. Current route-first reaction-local metadata/index checks and fingerprint admission ranking add bounded CPU work under the same per-input wall cap; per-arm compute is not equal.

route_first_additional_center_limits.scope: Only existing partition-valid outer reverse outcomes; preserve original-target crossing-bond signatures before normalization. No additional reverse enumeration, catalog or model work.
route_first_additional_center_limits.selection: Prefer typed role-conforming guides and cover distinct known cut centers before alternate rules at the same center; retain approximate, unknown, unary and explicit fallback plans under distinct safe keys.
route_first_additional_center_limits.status: retained_in_reviewed_v13_source; development pre-evidence 6/12; actual comparison not run

route_first_additional_index_limits.accounting: Same bounded catalog-index row pass; report extra substructure checks explicitly. This is additional CPU work inside the unchanged wall/row/fingerprint limits, not equal CPU work to v1.

route_first_additional_query_limits.accounting: Additional bounded normalization work inside the unchanged wall/catalog/fingerprint/combination/product/route/model limits; not equal CPU work to previous attempts. Freeze the reviewed runtime bytes and effective counters before execution.
route_first_additional_query_limits.policy: Prefer fully position-corresponding typed hints; retain the existing safe approximate hint on typed failure or exhaustion; one tuple per raw outcome; explicit fallback separately labelled.
route_first_additional_query_limits.trial_unit: One precursor-part representative construction/role-validation attempt; no-placeholder part validation is also charged against both the per-outcome and per-search limits.

route_first_additional_topology_limits.legacy_unknown: Unknown/truncated/budget/unsupported does not prune eligibility. Cached statically proven single-cross bridge restriction is independent of per-target enumeration completion.
route_first_additional_topology_limits.reverse_work: One existing reverse call per rule-target, cumulative raw outcomes stay within original cap4; no protected retries or extra calls.
route_first_additional_topology_limits.scope: Inner rule eligibility proof; local single-cross-edge query restriction also steers existing reverse enumeration.
route_first_additional_topology_limits.status: retained_in_reviewed_v13_source; development pre-evidence 6/12; actual comparison not run

route_first_fingerprint_admission_reserv.accounting: Same 65,536 total fingerprint limit and fixed products/routes/deadline; one callback fingerprint is a checked contract, not a sandbox for arbitrary callback CPU.
route_first_fingerprint_admission_reserv.policy: The initial hit is charged to generation. Generation cannot spend the reserved portion. Admission may use any globally remaining calls; select a deterministic bounded pending subset that can pay zero-or-one rank fingerprint and at most one callback fingerprint per product. Audit already eligible products after generation ceiling.

route_first_phase_two_scheduling.accounting: Separate preparation rule inspections and reverse normalization from execution catalog rows, quality attempts and deferred work. Preparation and indivisible full catalog queries may still exhaust shared budgets; no complete fairness guarantee.
route_first_phase_two_scheduling.policy: Prepare existing bounded inner rules and reverse guides, stable typed-first within each outer plan, execute one guide per outer plan per sweep. Rule-selection order remains unchanged.
route_first_phase_two_scheduling.status: retained_in_reviewed_v13_source; development pre-evidence 6/12; actual comparison not run
route_first_phase_two_scheduling.work_limits: Existing 8 outer plans, 4 inner rules per target, raw4 per reverse call, 512 total rule inspections and all catalog/fingerprint/combination/product/deadline caps unchanged.

route_first_pre_evidence_entry.interpretation: Six of twelve inputs pass unchanged pre-evidence gates and strict route audit in the model-free diagnostic. This permits the fixed actual-comparison entry; it is not all-step forward support, 3D qualification, or primary success.

route_first_reaction_pool_limits.accounting: Additional bounded substructure matching and graph metadata CPU work in the same catalog index pass, within original wall/row/fingerprint limits; not equal CPU effort to the previous arm.
route_first_reaction_pool_limits.policy: Fixed arithmetic midpoint of full and stereo-protected local raw feature counts, ceil then original bins. With complete metadata, use a complete exact normalized-role index or a complete identical-atom-set same-site hint index when applicable; otherwise use midpoint features with ordinary global buckets. An incomplete role index disables that indexed subset only and retains independently complete midpoint features. Incomplete, truncated, failed or budget-exhausted query metadata uses uncached legacy full-guide features with no index. Actual caller-role checks and full-guide fingerprints remain unchanged.

route_first_source_stereo_precheck.accounting: Additional bounded stereo perception, not equal CPU work. No extra role matching, chemistry or catalog scan. Existing total caps unchanged.
route_first_source_stereo_precheck.policy: Reuse route_audit.stereo_state fully_specified as an existing necessary condition for every concrete source reactant. Check ranked already-visited candidates only until top_k is filled, preserving anchored/ordinary reservation.
route_first_source_stereo_precheck.status: retained_in_reviewed_v13_source; development pre-evidence 6/12; actual comparison not run
route_first_source_stereo_precheck.unknown: Perception failure, budget or deadline retains candidate at legacy rank; incomplete nearest selection not cached.

frozen_protocol.source_hash_preverification: Driver pre-child source hashing is separately timed outside 960s CLI wall cap. Model/catalog loading and constructor verification inside each CLI are included.
frozen_protocol.source_policy: Read immutable baseline/feature snapshots, verify full runtime source hashes immediately before each child, isolate imports and prevent enclosing repository Git provenance from being mistaken for snapshot provenance.
